column3: Model fallbacks: a commit observer on pi.live runFailure model_error switches to the next owner fallback via conv.configure and submits a continue; sticky, one try per model per failure streak
column4: Capy moves to the next connection with a note; Ingle has one key per provider, so the next model stands in for the next connection. A commit observer is how the failures plugin already reads runFailure; continue is pi's own resume. Going back to the first model automatically is left out: it would need a probe per turn
